How heavy is the night The same
Isaac Watts printed it in 1707 in Hymns and Spiritual Songs, Book I, no. 98, under 1 Corinthians 1:30.
1 Corinthians 1:30 the verse printed above it
The words as Watts printed them, 20 lines.
Watts printed the hymn under 1 Corinthians 1:30. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption. 1 CORINTHIANS 1:30 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ 1 CORINTHIANS 1
Our guilty spirits dread To meet the wrath of heaven But, in his righteousness array'd, We see our sins forgiven. STANZA II
